title: Target Sum Combinations
prompt:
Given a list of distinct positive integers candidates and a positive integer target, return every unique combination of candidates whose values sum to target. Each candidate may be used any number of times. Two combinations are the same if they use the same values the same number of times, regardless of order.

Return a list of combinations; the order of combinations and the order within each combination do not matter. If none exist, return an empty list.

Example:
  sum_combinations([2, 3, 5], 8) -> [[2, 2, 2, 2], [2, 3, 3], [3, 5]]   (any order)
